blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Canonical GLDT ledger6c7su-kiaaa-aaaar-qaira-cai on Internet Computer accounts for99.1178% of the October19 census circulation. The current canister API read, updated2026-10-19T07:03:40.065868, reports sole controller leu43-oiaaa-aaaaq-aadgq-cai and module hash75f5076c0b91cccd7d1d26f718d8645ff3e9be11403936aa74e399647b6c57e8 (https://ic-api.internetcomputer.org/api/v3/canisters/6c7su-kiaaa-aaaar-qaira-cai). The controller's own API identifies it as ORIGYN Root, controlled by lnxxh-yaaaa-aaaaq-aadha-cai (https://ic-api.internetcomputer.org/api/v3/canisters/leu43-oiaaa-aaaaq-aadgq-cai). Current controller state supersedes the older sns_root_canister_id=tw2vt-hqaaa-aaaaq-aab6a-cai metadata. The installed module hash matches the official stock DFINITY ICRC ledger in ledger-suite-icrc-2025-01-21; its published ledger.did has ICRC transfer/approval/history methods but no admin holder blacklist, freeze, pause or arbitrary-holder burn (https://github.com/dfinity/ic/releases/tag/ledger-suite-icrc-2025-01-21; https://github.com/dfinity/ic/releases/download/ledger-suite-icrc-2025-01-21/ledger.did). ICRC1 debit/burn is caller-account based and ICRC2 transfer_from requires holder allowance. The root controller can install replacement ledger Wasm behind live balances, establishing direct upgrade-only Possible even without a current holder-targeted Yes path. Existing EVM representations on Ethereum, Base and Arbitrum at0x86856814e74456893cfc8946bedcbb472b5fa856 use the OpenZeppelin ERC20+Ownable+ERC20Permit Token: stock transfer/transferFrom, no freeze, blacklist, pause or seizure; burn1-burn4 burn msg.sender only; onlyOwner mint/batchMint/withdrawEth/updateMinAmount/updateOwner do not authorize victim burns. Exact Ethereum and Arbitrum source APIs https://eth.blockscout.com/api/v2/smart-contracts/0x86856814e74456893cfc8946bedcbb472b5fa856 and https://arbitrum.blockscout.com/api/v2/smart-contracts/0x86856814e74456893cfc8946bedcbb472b5fa856; Base verified source https://basescan.org/address/0x86856814e74456893cfc8946bedcbb472b5fa856#code. Ethereum26224761 (2026-10-19T06:14:23Z) owner remains0x70ae25592209b57f62b3a3e832ab356228a2192c, implementation slot0. Base0.881% and Ethereum0.0013% are subthreshold; the Arbitrum code adds no holder-facing control. No declared parent. Reserve denominator is100% locked GLD NFT certificates over allocated physical gold, identified in the reserve sidecar as Bity Tokenisation SA certificates with Loomis Schweiz AG, Kloten custody; allocated commodity custody counts categorically as custodial reserve exposure (https://docs.gold-dao.org/other/audit-reports). Thus100% qualifying custodial reserve exposure provides a secondary Upstream basis, not a reason to remove the stronger direct Possible status. GLD/GLDT same-symbol matching is not a tracked-stablecoin parent relationship, but the physical custody remains a genuine reserve exposure.
